rahul: Hi team — we just got an invoice that is ~22% lower than the dashboard for our private VPC deployment after last night's maintenance. Billing dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens, invoice shows ~950k. Can you help?

elaine: hey @rahul — sorry for the pain. Can you confirm you saw any agent restarts / host updates around 03:00-04:00 UTC? Also can you share the meter-agent version?

rahul: we did a standard OS patch + logrotate at 03:10. meter-agent shows v1.8.2 in /opt/redwood/bin. No manual restarts reported.

mike: quick thought — did logrotate use copytruncate? copytruncate can truncate open files which sometimes interacts badly with our agent's on-disk write checkpointing.

rahul: yes we use copytruncate (legacy config).

elaine: can you paste a slice of the agent logs from ~02:50-03:30? a few lines around rotation and any replay/flush messages would help.

rahul: pasted below (redacted). note the logrotate timestamp then a short gap and then agent resumes.

```
Mar 14 02:59:58 host1 redwood-meter-agent[21456]: INFO checkpoint: last_seq=1648232 persisted
Mar 14 03:10:03 host1 logrotate[3321]: rotating log /var/log/redwood/meter.log, copytruncate
Mar 14 03:10:03 host1 redwood-meter-agent[21456]: INFO signal: SIGHUP received, reopen logs
Mar 14 03:10:03 host1 redwood-meter-agent[21456]: INFO flush: flushed 63 batches to disk
Mar 14 03:10:04 host1 redwood-meter-agent[21456]: WARN replay: detected incomplete batch at offset 0x3f2a, dropping tail
Mar 14 03:10:04 host1 redwood-meter-agent[21456]: INFO resume: replay complete, resuming normal write
Mar 14 03:11:10 host1 redwood-meter-agent[21456]: INFO checkpoint: last_seq=1648295 persisted
```

mike: that WARN is suspicious — "incomplete batch" + copytruncate + SIGHUP sequence. Our agent persists batched events to a rotating file and expects writers to close + rename. copytruncate will truncate the file in-place while the agent still has an fd open; that can leave a partial batch at EOF that the replay code currently drops (counts not persisted).

sre-oncall: tagging the observations: (1) partial-batch drop on copytruncate leads to undercount (2) agent checkpointing semantics assume atomic rotate + reopen rather than copytruncate.

elaine: action items for now: can you (rahul) switch your logrotate from copytruncate to the default move+create and send SIGUSR1 or SIGHUP to the agent so it reopens new files? That should avoid partial truncation. If you can't change it now, enable the temporary mitigation: increase checkpoint frequency so fewer batches are buffered (set checkpoint_interval_seconds=30) and restart the agent.

rahul: we can try move+create this afternoon. For immediate reconciliation, is there a safe way to recover the dropped tokens so invoices match the dashboard?

mike: unfortunately once the agent drops an incomplete tail batch we only have what was persisted to the ledger; the HTTP audit log still shows the requests. We can reconcile by re-processing server-side audit logs to reconstruct token counts for that host/time range. That will be a manual reconcile and should be safe for billing credit.

elaine: I'll open a billing reconcile ticket with finance + engineering. @billing-bot do you need any special artifacts?

billing-bot: Received: please attach the following: (1) agent logs slice (02:50-03:30), (2) audit log extract for host1 (02:50-03:30), (3) current ledger snapshot and invoice id. Billing will validate reconstructed token counts.

mike: dev note: we should harden the replay code to detect copytruncate vs rotate and avoid dropping partial batches — or keep a small journal of the tail so we can attempt safe replay. I'll propose a patch (v1.8.3) that changes the rotate handling and adds metrics for "dropped_tail_batches".

elaine: rahul — can you confirm after you switch logrotate we'll monitor for a full day and then either run the reconcile or apply a credit depending on the delta?

rahul: confirmed. I'll change rotate to move+create now, schedule a quick process restart at 14:05 local, and upload logs for the ticket. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: followup: creating a small internal runbook for support engineers about copytruncate interactions and the immediate config/workarounds. Will link it in the ticket.

mike: patch notes for tracking: v1.8.3 (WIP) — detect file inode changes, refuse copytruncate, log explicit instruction to operator, metric: meter.dropped_tail_batches, and safe-replay attempt.

elaine: marking this thread for billing reconciliation and eng patch. I'll update once finance confirms credit or adjustment.

billing-bot: Ticket #BILL-4829 created, priority=P2. Attachments: pending.

rahul: thanks all, appreciate it.

elaine: closing the loop when billing posts outcome.
